Put \(x = \frac{\pi}{2} - h\), so \(h \to 0\) and \(\operatorname{cosec} x = \frac{1}{\cos h}\).
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{\frac{1}{\cos h} - 1}{h^2} = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{1 - \cos h}{h^2\cos h} = \lim_{h \to 0}\left[\frac{2\sin^2\left(\frac{h}{2}\right)}{h^2}\cdot\frac{1}{\cos h}\right] = \frac{1}{2}\cdot 1\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{1}{2}\)

Divide numerator and denominator by \(x - a\) and use \(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^n - a^n}{x - a} = n\,a^{n-1}\).
\(\lim_{x \to a}\frac{\sin x - \sin a}{\sqrt[5]{x} - \sqrt[5]{a}} = \frac{\lim_{x \to a}\frac{\sin x - \sin a}{x - a}}{\lim_{x \to a}\frac{x^{\frac{1}{5}} - a^{\frac{1}{5}}}{x - a}} = \frac{\cos a}{\frac{1}{5}a^{\frac{1}{5} - 1}} = \frac{\cos a}{\frac{1}{5}a^{-\frac{4}{5}}}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= 5a^{\frac{4}{5}}\cos a\)

Put \(x = \pi + h\), so \(h \to 0\), \(\cos x = -\cos h\) and \((\pi - x)^2 = h^2\). Rationalise the numerator.
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{\sqrt{5 - \cos h} - 2}{h^2} = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{(5 - \cos h) - 4}{h^2\left(\sqrt{5 - \cos h} + 2\right)} = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{1 - \cos h}{h^2}\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{5 - \cos h} + 2}\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\times\frac{1}{2 + 2} = \frac{1}{8}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{1}{8}\)

Write \(\cos x - \sqrt{3}\sin x = 2\left(\frac{1}{2}\cos x - \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin x\right) = 2\cos\left(x + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)\).
Put \(x = \frac{\pi}{6} + h\), so \(h \to 0\), \(x + \frac{\pi}{3} = \frac{\pi}{2} + h\) and \(\pi - 6x = -6h\).
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{2\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2} + h\right)}{-6h} = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{-2\sin h}{-6h} = \frac{2}{6}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{1}{3}\)

Put \(x = 1 + h\), so \(h \to 0\). Then \(1 - x^2 = -2h - h^2\) and \(\sin(\pi x) = \sin(\pi + \pi h) = -\sin(\pi h)\).
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{-h(2 + h)}{-\sin(\pi h)} = \lim_{h \to 0}\left[\frac{\pi h}{\sin(\pi h)}\cdot\frac{2 + h}{\pi}\right] = 1 \times \frac{2}{\pi}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{2}{\pi}\)

Put \(x = \frac{\pi}{6} + h\), so \(h \to 0\) and \(\pi - 6x = -6h\).
\(2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{6} + h\right) - 1 = 2\left(\frac{1}{2}\cos h + \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\sin h\right) - 1 = \sqrt{3}\sin h - (1 - \cos h)\)
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{\sqrt{3}\sin h - (1 - \cos h)}{-6h} = \lim_{h \to 0}\left[-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6}\cdot\frac{\sin h}{h} + \frac{1}{6}\cdot\frac{1 - \cos h}{h^2}\cdot h\right] = -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6} + 0\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{6} = -\frac{1}{2\sqrt{3}}\)

Write \(\cos x + \sin x = \sqrt{2}\sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{4}\right)\). Put \(x = \frac{\pi}{4} + h\), so \(h \to 0\), \(x + \frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2} + h\) and \(4x - \pi = 4h\).
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{2}\cos h}{16h^2} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{16}\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{1 - \cos h}{h^2} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{16}\times\frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{32}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{1}{16\sqrt{2}}\)

Write \(\sqrt{3}\cos x + \sin x = 2\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cos x + \frac{1}{2}\sin x\right) = 2\cos\left(x - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\).
Put \(x = \frac{\pi}{6} + h\), so \(h \to 0\) and \(6x - \pi = 6h\).
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{2 - 2\cos h}{36h^2} = \frac{2}{36}\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{1 - \cos h}{h^2} = \frac{1}{18}\times\frac{1}{2}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{1}{36}\)

Put \(\sqrt{x} = t\) and \(\sqrt{a} = c\), so \(x = t^2\), \(a = c^2\) and \(t \to c\).
\(\lim_{t \to c}\frac{\sin t - \sin c}{t^2 - c^2} = \lim_{t \to c}\left[\frac{\sin t - \sin c}{t - c}\cdot\frac{1}{t + c}\right] = \cos c\cdot\frac{1}{2c}\)
Replacing \(c\) by \(\sqrt{a}\),
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{\cos\sqrt{a}}{2\sqrt{a}}\)

Put \(x = \frac{\pi}{2} + h\), so \(h \to 0\) and \((2x - \pi)^3 = 8h^3\).
Then \(\cos x = -\sin h\) and \(\cos 3x = \cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{2} + 3h\right) = \sin 3h\).
Numerator \(= \sin 3h - 3\sin h = (3\sin h - 4\sin^3 h) - 3\sin h = -4\sin^3 h\).
\(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{-4\sin^3 h}{8h^3} = -\frac{1}{2}\left(\lim_{h \to 0}\frac{\sin h}{h}\right)^3 = -\frac{1}{2}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= -\frac{1}{2}\)
